rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for apportioning amounts or assigning a task or time when no special emphasis is needed.

example.english: This year, the company decided to allot less funding to each department.
example.traditional: 公司今年分配畀各部門嘅經費少咗。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 fan1 pui3 bei2 gok3 bou6 mun4 ge3 ging1 fai3 siu2 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the distribution is explicitly decided by drawing lots.

example.english: This time, we allot the stalls by drawing lots.
example.traditional: 今次啲攤位係抽籤分配嘅。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 di1 taan1 wai2 hai6 cau1 cim1 fan1 pui3 ge3

rows.note: Use this especially when allotting a task or designating something for a particular purpose, rather than dividing a measured share.

example.english: The manager decided to allot this task to me.
example.traditional: 經理安排我跟進呢單客戶投訴。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 on1 paai4 ngo5 gan1 zeon3 ne1 daan1 haak3 wu6 tau4 sou3
